notes.title: Meet Rita!
notes.notes:
[p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45690039/9d26cc3b3d00c65a3557ed3ddbdb6921dab11dcc.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Hey, Master… remember your sweet childhood friend? 🥺[/p][p align="start"]Rita’s loyal, obedient, and just dying to be useful. She follows orders with a smile and maybe a moan. 😈
She's soft, sweet, and ready to be ruined. Be gentle… or don’t. She’ll thank you either way. 💦[/p]

notes.title: Meet Catherine!
notes.notes:
[p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45690039/cbf1e43257becd34834ef60fa50a3a63da99143a.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]She exiled and humiliated you. Now she’s gonna choke on regret… and maybe something else.😈[/p][p align="start"]Catherine’s that ruthless royal baddie, known as the “Bloody Beauty.” She doesn’t do mercy. She does domination.[/p][p align="start"]
But this time, you’re the one holding the leash. Ready to add her to your harem? 💋💦[/p]

notes.title: Meet Edwige!
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45690039/3bb05f644af9e0fc34fb26210d9789f2853638ea.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]The ex-wizard waifu who ghosted you? Yeah, she’s back. 🧿[/p][p align="start"]Edwige was scared of your power and that was a huge mistake. Now she’s silent, bitter, and secretly soo into being punished.[/p][p align="start"]You’re gonna make her kneel, and she’s gonna hate how much she loves it. 💜[/p]
